g.text: Nothing is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 or GPIO2, so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: Nothing is wired to SDA, SCL, GPIO1 or GPIO2, so no series diode is needed on the cell (docs/standard.md section 3).

g.text: 3.3M + 3.3M + 100n: D2 on 0.46 s, off 0.23 s (about 1.5 blinks a second). The maker's built board (1k, 470k, 1u) gave 0.33 s on, 0.33 s off.

g.desc: 3.3M + 3.3M + 100n: D2 on 0.46 s, off 0.23 s (about 1.5 blinks a second). The maker's built board (1k, 470k, 1u) gave 0.33 s on, 0.33 s off.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the timer and both LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common (VLOAD) feeds the timer and both LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: D1 = control line C, always lit (R3). D2 = test line T, blinks from the 555 output (R4). Red LEDs, 1.3k each: about 1 mA from a cell.

g.desc: D1 = control line C, always lit (R3). D2 = test line T, blinks from the 555 output (R4). Red LEDs, 1.3k each: about 1 mA from a cell.

g.text: C2 = supply decoupling next to the timer (not in the maker's circuit; same part as C1).

g.desc: C2 = supply decoupling next to the timer (not in the maker's circuit; same part as C1).

g.text: 555 astable, as the maker drew it: R1 = RA (VLOAD to DIS), R2 = RB (DIS to THR/TRIG), C1 = timing capacitor.

g.desc: 555 astable, as the maker drew it: R1 = RA (VLOAD to DIS), R2 = RB (DIS to THR/TRIG), C1 = timing capacitor.
